name: retail-merchant-operations
description: This plugin is for retail merchandising and operations leaders. With its skills, you can ask data questions in plain language and get an answer with a chart. The analytics skill shows each SQL query for your approval and runs only read-only queries. A weekly merchant briefing ranks the top five category issues by revenue impact, with a likely cause and an action for each. From a funnel export, you can find where shoppers drop off and estimate the revenue at stake. You can also get a plain-language explanation of a demand forecast and a morning digest of supply chain exceptions, ranked by severity. For product listings, you can generate titles and descriptions in your brand voice for search engines and AI-powered search. The skills work from files that you upload. When one is available, they also use an AWS Quick Sight dataset or a data warehouse connection, so you don't need a connector. Check the figures against your system of record before you act on them.
